idea-plugin.name: Lazy Translator
idea-plugin.description:
Translate variable names and text with AI, right inside the editor.

Features:
  • Select Chinese text and translate it into an English variable name
  • One-click conversion to camelCase / PascalCase / snake_case / UPPER_SNAKE_CASE / kebab-case
  • Reverse translation: English selection is translated back to Chinese
  • Works with any OpenAI-compatible API (OpenAI, DeepSeek, Moonshot, Ollama, ...)
  • Your text is sent only to the AI endpoint you configure - no data is collected
Usage: select text in the editor, right-click and choose "翻译变量名" (Alt+T), or use "快速翻译替换" (Alt+Shift+T) to replace with the default naming format directly.
Configuration: Settings → Tools → Lazy Translator.

简单翻译（Lazy Translator）：选中代码里的中文，右键「翻译变量名」即可翻译成英文变量名， 支持 camelCase / PascalCase / snake_case / UPPER_SNAKE_CASE / kebab-case 格式选择并直接替换； 选中英文则反向翻译为中文。兼容任意 OpenAI 接口（DeepSeek / Moonshot / Ollama 等）。 配置入口：Settings → Tools → Lazy Translator。
